findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - CI fails after a clean review or after the owner records an acceptance, and the coordinator runs or repeats `--resolve`.
The refusal can still say `forge close` when `forge next` says `forge work`. `resolve_refusal` passes an empty pull-request map to `_item` at `src/forge/nextstep.py:1159`, so `_item` cannot see the failed CI checks at lines 1051–1056 and `_item_readiness` cannot select `checks failed` at line 893. The earlier finding's repeated-choice and failed-check behavior is therefore not fully repaired.
